id: 10_Three Voltmeter Method Basic Electrical Engineering laboratory All Branches of B
title: 电工实验：三电压表法测线圈（国内版）
source_doc: course/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/10_Three Voltmeter Method Basic Electrical Engineering laboratory All Branches of B.md
author_source: project/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/10_Three Voltmeter Method Basic Electrical Engineering laboratory All Branches of B（国内版）/src.py

points.K14: 阻抗三角形求电阻感抗
points.S1: 电感线圈：带电不拆，断开有感应电压
points.S2: 万用表测电压：握法和档位

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台前，台上有一个铁心线圈和三块电压表
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at an electrical lab bench with an iron-core coil and three analog voltmeters with blank dials, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天用三块电压表，摸清一个线圈！
overlay: 电工实验：三电压表法测线圈

shots.scene: 线圈图标旁有两个问号：电阻和电感
shots.prompt_en: An iron-core coil icon with two question mark bubbles beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 它的电阻多大？电感多大？

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一个镇流线圈翻看，一脸疑惑
shots.prompt_en: The young male student turns a heavy iron-core choke coil over in his hands, looking puzzled.
shots.narration: 阿杰拿着线圈：这东西怎么量？

shots.scene: 小研指着桌上三块电压表微笑
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student smiles and points at three voltmeters lined up on the bench.
shots.narration: 小研说：三块电压表就能算出来。

shots.scene: 王老师在空白黑板前，旁边是线圈图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stands at a blank blackboard next to a large coil icon.
shots.narration: 三电压表法，专门测线圈的电阻和电感。

shots.scene: 线圈内部画成一个电阻加一个电感串联
shots.prompt_en: A coil icon opened up to show a small resistor and an inductor symbol in series inside. No people.
shots.narration: 线圈可以看成电阻和电感串在一起。

shots.scene: 台上摆着线圈、三块电压表、一块电流表
shots.prompt_en: On a bench: an iron-core choke coil, three AC voltmeters and one AC ammeter, all with blank dials. No people.
shots.narration: 准备线圈、三块交流电压表、一块电流表。

shots.scene: 滑线变阻器和一捆导线
shots.prompt_en: A sliding rheostat and a bundle of connecting wires on the bench. No people.
shots.narration: 再备一只变阻器当限流电阻，和导线。

shots.scene: 电表表盘特写，指针式动铁结构图标
shots.prompt_en: Close-up icon of an analog moving-iron meter with a blank dial and a simple iron vane symbol inside. No people.
shots.narration: 交流电表常用动铁式，按量程选表。

shots.scene: 小研用万用表通断档逐根测导线，屏幕空白
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student tests each unconnected wire with a multimeter set to continuity; the display is blank.
shots.narration: 导线先用万用表通断档测一遍。

shots.scene: 简化电路图：电源、熔断器、调压器
shots.prompt_en: A simple circuit diagram icon: an AC source, a fuse and a round variable autotransformer. No people.
shots.narration: 电源经熔断器，接到调压器上。

shots.scene: 调压器后面，电流表、电阻、线圈串成一串
shots.prompt_en: Circuit icon: after the autotransformer, an ammeter, a resistor and a coil connected in one series chain. No people.
shots.narration: 电流表、电阻、线圈串成一路。

shots.scene: 三个电压表图标分别跨在总电压、电阻、线圈上
shots.prompt_en: Three voltmeter icons: the first across the whole chain, the second across the resistor, the third across the coil. No people.
shots.narration: 三块电压表：测总电压、电阻、线圈。

shots.scene: 箭头沿串联回路流过，电流处处相同
shots.prompt_en: Arrows flow around the series chain of ammeter, resistor and coil, all the same size. No people.
shots.narration: 串联回路里，电流处处一样大。

shots.scene: 表盘上画波浪符号的电表打勾，画直线符号的打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two meter icons: one with a wave symbol and a green check, one with a straight-line symbol crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 交流电路，要用交流电表。

shots.scene: 老周在电路图里给电表符号旁加一个波浪号
shots.prompt_en: The older man draws a small wave symbol next to a meter circle on a blank circuit diagram.
shots.narration: 画图时，交流表要标上交流符号。

shots.scene: 阿杰先把串联的一路连好，电压表还放在一边
shots.prompt_en: The young male student first connects the series chain on the bench while the three voltmeters still sit unconnected aside.
shots.narration: 接线先接串联的那一路。

shots.scene: 最后把电压表一块块并上去
shots.prompt_en: The young male student then connects the voltmeters one by one across the parts of the circuit.
shots.narration: 最后再把电压表一块块并上去。

shots.scene: 四个步骤图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four step icons in a row: a circuit diagram, a power switch turning on, a meter being read, a power switch turning off. No people.
shots.narration: 实验四步：接线、合闸、读数、断电。

shots.scene: 王老师检查后点头，阿杰合上电源开关
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks the wiring and nods; then the young male student switches on the bench power.
shots.narration: 检查无误，才能合上电源。

shots.scene: 小研在空白记录表上写下读数
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes readings in a blank data sheet beside the meters.
shots.narration: 读出各表的数，马上记录。

shots.scene: 阿杰拉下电源开关
shots.prompt_en: The young male student switches off the bench power switch.
shots.narration: 读完数，断开电源开关。

shots.scene: 实验台全景，五件器材旁各有编号小旗
shots.prompt_en: A wide view of the bench: autotransformer, multimeter, ammeter and two voltmeters, each with a small numbered flag. No people.
shots.narration: 认清调压器、电流表和三块电压表。

shots.scene: 万用表拨到交流电压档，当第一块电压表
shots.prompt_en: A multimeter with its dial set to the AC voltage position, connected as the first voltmeter; the display is blank. No people.
shots.narration: 第一块电压表可以用万用表交流档。

shots.scene: 四个空白读数框
shots.prompt_en: Four blank reading boxes in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 每次要读四个数。

shots.scene: 阿杰慢慢转动调压器旋钮
shots.prompt_en: The young male student slowly turns the knob of the autotransformer.
shots.narration: 用调压器从低往高，加一个电压。

shots.scene: 小研依次看电流表、两块电压表，在空白表格上记录
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads the ammeter and the two voltmeters in turn and writes on a blank data sheet.
shots.narration: 依次读电流、V2、V3，记下来。

shots.scene: 调压器旋钮再转一点，重复读数
shots.prompt_en: The autotransformer knob is turned a little further, and the readings are taken again.
shots.narration: 再换一个电压，重复一遍。

shots.scene: 欣欣摆手提醒，旁边额定值标牌图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves a paw in warning beside a blank rating plate icon.
shots.narration: 电压别超过线圈和电表的额定值。

shots.scene: 小组四五个人围着表格，每人一行
shots.prompt_en: A small group of students around a blank data table, each pointing at a different row.
shots.narration: 多测几组，组里每人各算一组。

shots.scene: 阿杰把调压器旋钮转回零位
shots.prompt_en: The young male student turns the autotransformer knob all the way back to the zero position.
shots.narration: 做完了，先把调压器转回零。

shots.scene: 随后拉下电源开关
shots.prompt_en: Then he switches off the bench power switch.
shots.narration: 然后再断开电源。

shots.scene: 一张空白宽表格，表头只有图标
shots.prompt_en: A wide blank data table with many columns whose headers are only small icons. No people.
shots.narration: 表格里记电压、电流和计算结果。

shots.scene: 老周在白板上写分数式，只有字母符号
shots.prompt_en: The older man writes a fraction with letter symbols on a whiteboard, no words.
shots.narration: 先算功率因数。

shots.scene: 欣欣比出记住的手势
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot taps its head with a paw as if memorizing.
shots.narration: 公式记住会用，不必现场推导。

shots.scene: 计算器图标显示空白，旁边角度符号
shots.prompt_en: A calculator icon with a blank display next to an angle symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 再求出相角和它的正弦。

shots.section_title: 阻抗三角形求电阻感抗
shots.scene: 直角三角形：斜边阻抗，底边电阻，竖边感抗
shots.prompt_en: A right triangle diagram: the long side for impedance, the base for resistance, the vertical side for reactance, with an angle at the corner. No people.
shots.narration: 画出阻抗三角形。
overlay: 阻抗三角形求电阻感抗

shots.section_title: 阻抗三角形求电阻感抗
shots.scene: 第三块电压表读数除以电流表读数
shots.prompt_en: The third voltmeter icon divided by the ammeter icon, with an equals sign. No people.
shots.narration: 阻抗等于V3除以电流。

shots.section_title: 阻抗三角形求电阻感抗
shots.scene: 三角形里的角度标记为相角
shots.prompt_en: The angle at the corner of the right triangle highlights. No people.
shots.narration: 三角形里的这个角，就是相角。

shots.section_title: 阻抗三角形求电阻感抗
shots.scene: 三角形底边和竖边分别高亮
shots.prompt_en: The base of the triangle highlights, then the vertical side highlights. No people.
shots.narration: 电阻乘余弦，感抗乘正弦。

shots.scene: 感抗图标除以一个旋转的圆圈符号
shots.prompt_en: A reactance icon divided by a spinning circle symbol for angular frequency. No people.
shots.narration: 电感等于感抗除以角频率。

shots.scene: 小研在表格最后一栏填好数字，打勾
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student fills in the last column of a blank table and adds a green check mark.
shots.narration: 频率用电源频率，电感就求出来了。

shots.scene: 空白封面教材和一只举起的手
shots.prompt_en: A textbook with a blank cover next to a raised hand icon. No people.
shots.narration: 课后对照教材复习，有疑问就问。

shots.section_title: 电感线圈：带电不拆，断开有感应电压
shots.scene: 线圈图标断开时冒出小火花
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an iron-core coil circuit being broken apart with a small spark at the gap. No people.
shots.narration: 线圈有电感，突然断开会产生感应电压。
overlay: 电感线圈：带电不拆，断开有感应电压

shots.section_title: 电感线圈：带电不拆，断开有感应电压
shots.scene: 通电时拔线圈接线的手被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand pulling a plug lead off a coil terminal while the circuit is powered, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 通电时，不许拔线圈上的接线。

shots.section_title: 电感线圈：带电不拆，断开有感应电压
shots.scene: 阿杰先回零、断电，再去拆线圈接线
shots.prompt_en: The young male student turns the autotransformer to zero, switches off the power, then removes the coil leads.
shots.narration: 先回零、断电，再拆线圈接线。

shots.section_title: 万用表测电压：握法和档位
shots.scene: 手握表笔，手指在护指环后面，打勾
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a hand holding a multimeter probe with fingers behind the finger guard, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 握表笔，手指放在护指环后面。
overlay: 万用表测电压：握法和档位

shots.section_title: 万用表测电压：握法和档位
shots.scene: 手指捏住表笔金属尖的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of fingers pinching the metal tip of a probe, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 手指别碰表笔的金属部分。

shots.section_title: 万用表测电压：握法和档位
shots.scene: 小研核对表笔插孔和旋钮档位
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks that the probe leads are in the voltage jacks and the dial is on AC voltage before measuring.
shots.narration: 测之前，核对插孔和档位。

shots.section_title: 万用表测电压：握法和档位
shots.scene: 表笔插在电流孔却去测电压的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a multimeter with a probe lead in the current jack touching a voltage source, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 表笔插在电流孔去测电压，会短路。

shots.scene: 导线乱缠、悬空拉在仪表之间的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of tangled wires stretched tightly in the air between meters, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 导线别乱缠，别绷紧悬空。

shots.scene: 导线顺着台面整齐排列，长短合适
shots.prompt_en: Connecting wires laid neatly along the bench surface with suitable lengths. No people.
shots.narration: 长短合适，顺着台面摆整齐。

shots.scene: 阿杰的袖子挂到导线，小研提醒他
shots.prompt_en: The young male student's sleeve nearly catches a wire; the female graduate student points it out and he steps back.
shots.narration: 别让衣袖挂到线，拉脱线头很危险。

shots.scene: 线圈、三块电压表、电流表图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a coil, three voltmeters and an ammeter. No people.
shots.narration: 三块电压表加电流表，测出线圈参数。

shots.scene: 公式卡片和三角形图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blank formula card and a right triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 先算功率因数，再用三角形求解。

shots.scene: 回零旋钮、护指环表笔、整齐导线三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a knob at zero, a probe held behind its finger guard, and neatly laid wires. No people.
shots.narration: 回零断电再拆线，握好表笔理好线。

shots.scene: 欣欣在调压器回零、断电的实验台前挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye in front of a switched-off bench with the autotransformer knob at zero.
shots.narration: 安全做实验，下次见！
